detail.longDescription: Hi, I just wanted to ask how many of you guys are tired of Discord and the trash features they added. As a gamer, I remember how discord was a good platform for talking and hanging out but it's been a long time from that feeling so I made my own discord, I used to live in ultra restricted country ( not north korea) and when they start blocking discord all of us needed to immigrate to either TeamSpeak or Steam voice chat but these two also have some flaws; for example, TeamSpeak is an old app even the new one (Teamspeak 5) has some grandpa UI that not anyone enjoy it top on that you can't share or easily share files. So I made my own Discord/TeamSpeak clone. I hated that public Discord clone has a lot of complicated server setup. I wanted something that I don't need to set up for an hour, and it's also easy to work with, same as Discord but nothing complicated. Would this app be interested for you? also it's opensource
